seo.title: Website Developer
seo.description: Niraum Metals website designed and developed by Janak (James) Rokaya, full-stack developer in Kathmandu, Nepal.

hero.title: Website developer
hero.intro: This website and its admin panel were designed and built by Janak (James) Rokaya.

profile.title: Designed and developed by
profile.summary: Full-stack developer and final-year Computer Engineering student (IOE, Tribhuvan University) who builds and deploys production web apps with React, Node.js and MongoDB, and applies machine learning to real problems.

items.bilingual: Bilingual site in English and नेपाली, prerendered for fast loading and search engines.
items.data: Assay tables, charts and the deposit composition built from the mine scheme data, never typed by hand.
items.admin: Admin panel for content, products, deposit, assay data, inquiries, media and users, with an audit log.
items.api: Secure REST API: Node.js, Express and MongoDB, cookie-based sign-in, rate limits and captcha.
items.ops: Automated tests and a CI/CD pipeline that deploys the site and API after every check passes.
